input: Hire a personal trainer for three months

gold.taskTitle: Hire a Personal Trainer for Three Months
gold.taskDescription: Find and commit to a personal trainer for a three-month engagement to support the user's fitness goals.

questions.title: What is your primary fitness goal right now?
questions.description: Understand whether the goal is weight loss, muscle gain, injury recovery, general fitness, sport-specific training, or something else.

questions.title: Where do you want training sessions to take place?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to train at a commercial gym, private studio, outdoors, or at home.

questions.title: How many sessions per week are you expecting?
questions.description: Clarify the intended frequency of sessions to help scope trainer availability and cost.

questions.title: What is your budget per session or per month?
questions.description: Establish a clear spending range so trainer options can be filtered accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have any injuries or medical conditions to consider?
questions.description: Identify physical limitations or health considerations that would require a trainer with specific expertise or certifications.

questions.title: Do you prefer a trainer of a specific gender or communication style?
questions.description: Capture any personal preferences around trainer personality, motivational approach, or demographic that affect comfort and compatibility.

questions.title: Have you worked with a personal trainer before?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience to gauge how much guidance they need in selecting and vetting a trainer.
